module.purpose: Creates the initial React Flow store state from optional nodes, edges, viewport dimensions, and interaction configuration.
module.summary: This module assembles the complete default store used by the React integration. It selects controlled or default graph data, builds node, parent, edge, and connection lookup maps, adopts user nodes into internal representations, optionally computes an initial fit-to-bounds viewport, and returns standardized interaction, accessibility, selection, connection, and middleware state.
module.businessContext: Supports interactive node-based diagrams and workflow editors. Failure prevents React Flow from initializing graph data, viewport state, and core interaction behavior.
functions: getInitialState (~L20-154): Builds lookup maps, viewport state, and complete React Flow store defaults

mutationOfArg: Passes lookup maps and selected graph data to imported helpers that populate internal indexes.

detail.name: getInitialState
detail.signature: const getInitialState = ({ nodes, edges, defaultNodes, defaultEdges, width, height, fitView, fitViewOptions, minZoom = 0.5, maxZoom = 2, nodeOrigin, nodeExtent, zIndexMode = 'basic' }: { nodes?: Node[]; edges?: Edge[]; defaultNodes?: Node[]; defaultEdges?: Edge[]; width?: number; height?: number; fitView?: boolean; fitViewOptions?: FitViewOptions; minZoom?: number; maxZoom?: number; nodeOrigin?: NodeOrigin; nodeExtent?: CoordinateExtent; zIndexMode?: ZIndexMode } = {}): ReactFlowStore
preconditions: The argument is either omitted or is an object matching the declared parameter shape.
When fitView is used with positive-truthy width and height, the supplied node and edge data must be acceptable to the node-adoption and bounds-calculation dependencies.
postconditions: Returns a ReactFlowStore object with initialized node, parent, edge, and connection lookup maps.
Uses defaultNodes instead of nodes when defaultNodes is defined, and defaultEdges instead of edges when defaultEdges is defined.
Uses [0, 0] as the node origin and infiniteExtent as the node extent when those values are omitted.
Returns width and height as 0 when they are omitted.
Returns the default transform [0, 0, 1] unless fitView, width, and height are all truthy.
Sets fitViewQueued to the supplied fitView value or false when fitView is omitted.
Sets hasDefaultNodes and hasDefaultEdges according to whether the corresponding default arguments are defined.
invariants: The returned nodes and edges references are the selected storeNodes and storeEdges values.
The returned minZoom and maxZoom preserve supplied values or use 0.5 and 2 respectively.
The returned zIndexMode preserves the supplied value or uses 'basic'.
The returned store contains strict connection mode, enabled node and edge interaction defaults, and null runtime handles such as panZoom and domNode.
edgeCases: With no argument, nodes and edges are empty arrays, dimensions are 0, transform is [0, 0, 1], node origin is [0, 0], and fitViewQueued is false.
When defaultNodes or defaultEdges is an empty array, it takes precedence over the corresponding nodes or edges argument.
When fitView is true but width or height is falsy, the default transform [0, 0, 1] is retained while fitViewQueued remains true.
When fitView is true and width and height are truthy, the transform is computed from internal node bounds and fitView padding.
When fitViewOptions.padding is omitted during fitting, padding 0.1 is used.
stateMutations: Mutates newly allocated nodeLookup, parentLookup, connectionLookup, and edgeLookup maps while populating them from the selected nodes and edges.
Does not mutate caller-owned nodes, edges, defaultNodes, or defaultEdges directly.
detail.summary: Creates and returns the initial React Flow store state from supplied nodes, edges, viewport settings, and interaction configuration. It initializes lookup maps and optionally computes a viewport transform for fitting initialized nodes.

specTests.then: The returned state has empty nodes and edges, width 0, height 0, transform [0, 0, 1], minZoom 0.5, maxZoom 2, nodeOrigin [0, 0], zIndexMode 'basic', and fitViewQueued false.
